risk.rationale: F1 is CONFIRMED (0.75) and documents a single suspicious sign-in from AS9121 TTNET (TR) outside the account baseline, mapped to T1078.004. There are no rejected claims explaining it away and no data-quality conflicts. However, this is one isolated authentication anomaly, not a confirmed account takeover chain (no evidence of follow-on actions such as credential/password changes, MFA registration, mail rules, or lateral movement), so "contain" is not supported. It is also not "benign" because the signal is confirmed and unexplained. No conflicting or insufficient evidence requires human escalation. The appropriate disposition is to monitor the account for additional anomalous activity.
